name: app-oviah-wireframes-mid-fidelity-signup-onboarding-flow
title: OVIAH mid-fidelity wireframes: greyscale signup, onboarding and reminders screens in a row
whatItIs: Seven greyscale phone wireframes labelled 'Wireframes (Mid Fidelity)': create account, login, name and photo entry, date of birth, calendar setup, a setup-complete screen with a placeholder ring, and a reminders list with pill frequency options.
whatItMeans: Structural and honest; showing bare wireframes before the styled screens proves the layout was solved first.
techniques: Strip colour and imagery to test layout alone.
Sequence wireframes in the exact order a user experiences them.
Use placeholder circles for imagery not yet designed.

vocabulary.definition: A layout mockup with structure but no final visual style.
A temporary stand-in for content not yet finalised.
